mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen for three consecutive weeks (-45.6 to -28.0), reflecting an ongoing recovery momentum in discretionary shopping and recreation trips that should persist and push mobility further upward over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or lower than the mean over the last 28 days despite the three-week prior uptrend.

evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly delta dropped from +8.3 to +0.1

regime_hint: partial reopening with weak transit recovery

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -6.0 to 9.1 over two weeks, crossing zero
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises in the week immediately following the PARKS zero-crossing rather than declining.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days even though the GROCERY_PHARM-TRANSIT gap stays above 20 points.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has improved steadily for three consecutive weeks (-52.3 to -36.6), and this gradual restoration of transit usage directly expands the pool of people able to reach retail and recreation destinations, driving RETAIL_REC higher in the immediate next week.
